title: SPC Stats - Process Capability Index (Cpk)
text: Screen: SPC Stats. Feature: Process Capability Index (Cpk). Keyword: cpk. Description: Cpk = min((USL - Mean)/(3*SD), (Mean - LSL)/(3*SD)). It measures the actual process capability considering the mean centering.. How to Use: Refreshed every 30 seconds on the Dashboard. High Cpk (>1.33) indicates a high-quality process.. Solution / Troubleshooting: If Cpk is much lower than Cp, the process mean is shifted. Adjust recipe parameters/offsets..
